title: Scan and turn

diagram.extractedFrom: hand-drawn SVG, generated from Jeff's description (not a PDF)

setup: One 4yd x 4yd square. Lines for passer (with balls) and receiver on opposite sides of the square.
instructions: Receiver runs into square, then looks over shoulder as soon as they enter.
Coach points either to a side or straight forward, then puts down arm.
When coach puts down their arm, the passer passes to the receiver.
Receiver's action depends on which way coach pointed. If coach pointed forward, the receiver passes back to the original passer. If coach pointed to a side, the receiver turns in that direction.
coachingPoints: Look over your shoulder as soon as you enter the square.
